item.title: 'Mathematicians did not ask for this': math group calls on researchers to reject OpenAI
item.description: After OpenAI dropped 722 AI-generated math preprints on GitHub — then withdrew three within a day over a sign error — the Association for Human Mathematics called it "a demonstration of power, not scholarship" and urged mathematicians to stop collaborating with OpenAI.
